subject: english
question:
Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option.

On the _______ in the train he talked to his neighbours about politics and the new railways
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"entourage"** means a group of people attending or surrounding an important person. (नौकर-चाकर का दल)

 
 
• **Example: **The celebrity arrived at the event with a large** entourage.**
 
 
 
• The word **"journey"** refers to the act of traveling from one place to another, usually taking a long time. (यात्रा)
 
 
• **Example: **The** journey** to the remote village took several hours.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Entourage** (नौकर-चाकर का दल): A group of people attending or surrounding an important person.

 
 
• **Example:** The politician's** entourage** included advisors and security personnel.
 
 
 
• **Tourism** (पर्यटन): The commercial organization and operation of vacations and visits to places of interest.
 
 
• **Example:** **Tourism** is a major source of income for the island.
 
 
 
• **Itinerary** (यात्रा की रूपरेखा): A planned route or journey.
 
 
• **Example:** The travel agent provided us with a detailed **itinerary** for our trip.
 
 

 

31:Tb77,

The correct answer is: **Option 4**.
